info.title: Onchain Stock Data
info.description: Tokenized US-equity onchain data and verifiable Claude catalyst scoring for AI agents, paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base and Solana). Operator: x402 Inc. (APAC).

get.summary: List the xStocks registry of tokenized equities
get.description: Full xStocks registry with prices, volumes, and venues. `?tokenized=true` filters to onchain-traded names. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana).

parameters.name: tokenized
parameters.description: When true, return only xStocks that currently trade onchain.

get.summary: Get the registry detail for one stock ticker
get.description: Single-ticker detail record from the xStocks registry (e.g. /api/stocks/NVDA). Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana).

get.summary: Get the Backpack onchain IPO calendar
get.description: Backpack IPOs Onchain calendar (Superstate x Solana). Price: $0.01 USDC (Solana only).
Tokenized stock DEX liquidity and price deviation vs the underlying. Price: $0.01 USDC (Solana only).
Tokenized stock holders map and concentration scores. Price: $0.01 USDC (Solana only).

get.summary: List the curated alpha-signal posts feed
get.description: Curated Alpha Signals feed (owner-managed X post list). Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana).

post.summary: Generate an IC memo for one ticker
post.description: Generate an IC memo for a ticker. Price varies by depth: quick $0.50, standard $1.50, deep $3.00 USDC (Base or Solana).

ticker.description: US-equity ticker symbol to analyze, e.g. NVDA.

post.description: Claude buy/hold/sell predictions for multiple tickers. Price varies by depth: quick $0.50, standard $1.50, deep $3.00 USDC (Base or Solana).
x402 wrapper around Birdeye OHLCV for a Solana token. Body: { address, type, limit }. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana).

address.description: Solana token mint address to fetch candles for.

post.description: x402 wrapper around Perplexity recent-news research. Body: { ticker, lookback_hours }. Returns top-3 events + catalyst suggestions + citations. Price: $0.05 USDC (Base or Solana).

ticker.description: US-equity ticker symbol to research, e.g. NVDA.

get.summary: Get the weekly Claude stock portfolio
get.description: Current weekly Claude-selected 10-stock US equity portfolio with per-holding catalyst and thesis. Free, CORS-open.
Catalyst scorecard: resolved catalysts with hit/partial/miss verdicts and evidence URLs, and portfolio index vs SPY/QQQ. Free, CORS-open.

post.description: Submit a hypothesis to be scored. Body: { ticker, description, target_date }. Returns catalyst_id, estimated_eval_date, score_lookup_url. Free, CORS-open, rate-limited.

ticker.description: US-equity ticker symbol the catalyst applies to, e.g. NVDA.

description.description: Plain-text statement of the hypothesis to be judged.

get.description: Verdict lookup for a submitted catalyst. Returns `pending` until judged, then hit/partial/miss/na with evidence. Free, CORS-open.

parameters.name: catalyst_id
parameters.description: Catalyst id returned by the submit endpoint.
